title: Rainforest Canopy Run
pitch: Follow the canopy trail, collect three coins for points and temporary speed boosts, then reach the summit lookout.
target_players: Players who enjoy short exploration rounds.
core_loop: Follow the trail and collect three coins for points and speed boosts.
Touch the summit lookout and start another round.

systems.name: Canopy coins and timed speed boosts
systems.purpose: Give one point and a timed speed boost per coin per player each round.

systems.name: Lava vent
systems.purpose: Eliminate a player who touches the vent.

systems.name: Summit finish
systems.purpose: Award a win for reaching the summit with three points.

included_systems: Canopy coins and timed speed boosts
limitations: Points and wins belong to the current server session.

world_brief: A connected rainforest path leads over a canopy bridge to a summit lookout. Place three coins along the route and a lava vent beside the trail.
milestones: Place coins, the vent and the lookout.
Play two rounds with two players.
validation_goals: Each player collects each coin once per round.
The vent eliminates the player on contact.
A coin temporarily boosts speed and restores the original speed after twelve seconds.
